Proven experience migrating VDI workloads between hypervisors with minimal user disruption, using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or image-rebuild approaches. Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning. Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and multipathing, and storage performance/IOPS sizing for VDI. Strong experience with Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers. Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes. Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material. Exposure to Microsoft Hyper-V or Citrix DaaS / Citrix Cloud is desirable. Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
